externalGates.name: Isolated staging
externalGates.historicalRegisterState: **OPEN.** The founder previously confirmed that staging is not configured. Generic `.env`/`.env.local` Neon endpoints are not staging evidence.
externalGates.requiredEvidence: Named isolated branch/project, restricted web/worker URLs stored in a staging-only secret source, deployment identity, retention/reset policy and successful restore drill
externalGates.stopCondition: No staging claim, remote migration rehearsal, provider canary or production cutover
externalGates.qualification: CR1-045: generated historical clearances cannot satisfy this gate

externalGates.name: Restricted runtime
externalGates.historicalRegisterState: **LOCAL EVIDENCE ONLY.** Disposable PostgreSQL tests show non-superuser/non-`BYPASSRLS` patterns; exact deployed web and worker principals remain unproved.
externalGates.requiredEvidence: Read-only receipt from each deployed runtime login showing `rolsuper=false`, `rolbypassrls=false`, required grants, FORCE RLS catalog readiness and no owner membership/`SET ROLE` path
externalGates.stopCondition: No production-readiness certification for sensitive multi-tenant expansion
externalGates.qualification: CR1-045: generated historical clearances cannot satisfy this gate

externalGates.name: India commerce/tax
externalGates.historicalRegisterState: **OPEN.** No written Indian CA/tax-lawyer sign-off is present.
externalGates.requiredEvidence: Written decision for quote/order/invoice tax treatment, cancellation/refund, marketplace/merchant-of-record classification, payouts, withholding and record retention
externalGates.stopCondition: No M5/M6B acceptance or live customer-capital booking/payment launch
externalGates.qualification: CR1-045: generated historical clearances cannot satisfy this gate

externalGates.name: Google advertiser topology
externalGates.historicalRegisterState: **OPEN/STALE EVIDENCE.** Historical screenshots and discussion do not prove current Basic Access, advertiser-of-record classification or the permitted account/customer topology.
externalGates.requiredOwnerRole: Founder + Google Ads account owner/provider counsel
externalGates.requiredEvidence: Current authenticated access level, developer-token status, account hierarchy, customer/advertiser mapping, allowed API operations and paused create/readback evidence
externalGates.stopCondition: No Google live activation or universal control claim
externalGates.qualification: CR1-045: generated historical clearances cannot satisfy this gate

externalGates.name: Meta advertiser topology
externalGates.historicalRegisterState: **OPEN.** Source has versioned capability contracts, but current business/app/ad-account eligibility and permissions are not externally verified for CR1.
externalGates.requiredEvidence: Current app mode/review, business/ad-account/page/Instagram/pixel bindings, token permissions, feature eligibility and paused create/readback evidence
externalGates.stopCondition: No Meta live activation or universal control claim
externalGates.qualification: CR1-045: generated historical clearances cannot satisfy this gate

externalGates.name: Advertising economics
externalGates.historicalRegisterState: **PARTIAL.** Cost-plus direction with an admin-selected initial 3–5% markup is accepted; the recognized cost basis and tax/variance/refund rules are incomplete.
externalGates.requiredEvidence: Versioned definition of recognized cost `C`, markup bounds, tax, provider variance/overdelivery, cancellation, refund/wallet treatment, expiry and disclosure
externalGates.stopCondition: No final campaign financial contract or customer-capital pilot
externalGates.qualification: CR1-045: generated historical clearances cannot satisfy this gate

externalGates.name: Workforce separation policy
externalGates.historicalRegisterState: **PARTIAL.** Scoped delegation is accepted; exact production role combinations and checker/step-up/amount thresholds remain open.
externalGates.requiredEvidence: Approved role catalog, forbidden combinations, checker thresholds, safety-pause asymmetry, owner bootstrap and access-review cadence
externalGates.stopCondition: Implement deny-by-default safe baseline; no broad delegated production authority until approved
externalGates.qualification: CR1-045: generated historical clearances cannot satisfy this gate

externalGates.name: Support and service policy
externalGates.historicalRegisterState: **OPEN.** Staffing hours, inquiry SLA, escalation authority, retention and channel commitments are not fixed.
externalGates.requiredEvidence: Published operating hours, SLA targets, escalation matrix, staff capacity, channel consent policy and privacy/retention schedule
externalGates.stopCondition: No guaranteed response-time marketing claim or autonomous escalation beyond configured safe defaults
